name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Balance & Status Absorption (Remix)
archetype: High physical defense, Grass status control, and Fire/Rock coverage.
gym_duel_rationale: Squirtle provides high physical bulk with Withdraw and Water STAB. Pairing Squirtle with Route 22 Slugma unleashes super-effective Fire damage (Ember) against Steelix/Mime Jr., while Rock Throw gives neutral pressure against Aron/Psyduck.

roster.progression_notes: All 4 moves learned naturally by Lv. 13. Withdraw boosts Defense to shrug off Gyro Ball and Metal Claw hits.
Caught in Viridian Forest. Stun Spore paralyzes fast threats while Mega Drain provides sustainable HP recovery.
Caught on Route 22. Magma Armor prevents freeze, while Ember inflicts 2x super-effective Fire damage on Steelix/Mime Jr.

flex_bench.why_use: Caught on Route 22. Vital Spirit prevents sleep from Yawn, while Bite and Tackle deal reliable physical damage.
Caught on Route 1. Huge Power doubles its physical Attack stat, delivering surprisingly heavy hits.
